paite: Huan ni guk nung in Jesu'n atuam in tang sangtak ah Peter, Jakob leh a-unau Johan apaitouhpih hi.
heading: Mellamdanna / (Mar 9,2-13; Luk 9.28-36)
english: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.

paite: Huan ama uah amel omdan ahong lamdangta a; amai ni bang in ahong tang a, apuansilhte vuk bang in ahong ngouta hi.
english: He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

paite: Huan ngai dih, Mosi leh Elijah, amah kihoupih in akiang uah akilak uhi.
english: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.

paite: Huan Peter in Jesu ahoupih a, "Toupa, ei a di'n hiai a om ahoih, na utleh hiai ah aidakbuk thum ka bawl ding a; nang a ding in khat, Mosi a ding in khat, Elijah a ding in khat,” achi hi.
english: Peter answered and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

paite: Agen laitak in, mei ngoutak in amaute aliahta a; ngai dih, mei a kipan aw in, "Hiai ka Tapa deihtak, ka kipahna mahmah ahi; amah thu ngai un," achi hi.
english: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”

paite: Huan nungzuite'n huai azak un bokkhup in apuk ua, alau mahmah uhi.
english: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.

paite: Jesu'n amaute ahong khoih a, "Thou unla, lau kei un,” achi hi.
english: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”

paite: Huan adakkhia ua, Jesu kia lou ngal kuamah amuta kei uhi.
english: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.

paite: Huan tang a kipan akum lai un, Jesu'n akiang uah, "Misi lak a kipan Mihing Tapa athohnawn masiah na thil muh uh kuamah hilh kei un," chi in thu apia hi.
english: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”

paite: Huan anungzuite'n akiang ah, "Laigelhmite'n Elijah hong pai masa ding ahi, bangchidan a chi ahi ua?" chi in adong uhi.
english: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

paite: Ama'n, "Elijah ahong pai ding him ahi a, bangkim asiam hoih ding hi.
english: Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things;

paite: Himahleh ka hon hilh ahi, Elijah zaw ahong pai khinta, amah athei kei ua, atung ah a-utut un ahihzawta uhi. Huchi mah bang in Mihing Tapa in leng alak uah athuak sam ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”

paite: Huaitak in, nungzuite'n akiang ua Baptispa Johan thu gen ahi chih atheita uhi.
english: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.

paite: Huan mipi kiang ahong tun un mi khat akiang ah ahong pai a, ama a khukdin in,
heading: Pasal Naupang Dawimat Hihdamna / (Mar 9.14-29; Luk 9.37-43)
english: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,

paite: "Toupa ka tapa tung ah zahngai in, amah phungzawl vei ahi a, anak thuak tel mai; tamveipi mei ah apuklut a, tamveipi tui ah leng apuk nak hi.
english: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.

paite: Na nungzuite kiang ah ka hon pi a, ahihdam thei kei uh," achi hi.
english: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”

paite: Jesu'n, "Ginna nei lou leh khang genhakte aw, bang tan ahia ka hon thuakzoh ding, amah ka kiang ah hon pi un," chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n dawi atai a, asung a kipan apawt a; huai dak in naupang adamta hi.
english: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.

paite: Huai zoh in, atuam in Jesu kiang ah nungzuite ahong pai ua, "Bang achia kou delhkhe thei lou ka hi ua?" achi uhi.
english: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Na gintak louh ziak un ahi. Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, ankam tang khat bang ginna na neih uleh, hiai tang kiang ah, 'Hiai a kipan huai a pam ah va kisuan in,' na chi ding ua, akisuan mai ding; nou a ding in hihtheih louh bangmah a-om kei ding," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

paite: Akoi abang hitaleh, hichibang zaw thumna leh an ngawlna lou ngal in apaikhe kei ding hi.
english: But this kind doesn’t go out except by prayer and fasting.”

paite: Galili gam a a-om lai un Jesu'n akiang uah, "Mihing Tapa zaw mihingte khut ah matsak in a-om ding a, athat ding ua;
heading: Jesu'n Asihna Ding Genkhol Nawn / (Mar 9.30-32; Luk 9.43-45)
english: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,

paite: ani thum ni in kaihthoh in a-om ding hi," achi a, huchi in alungkham mahmah uhi.
english: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.

paite: Kapernaum khua ahong tun un, Peter kiang ah sumkhonte ahong pai ua, "Na pu un siah pe zel lou hia?" achi uhi.
heading: Tempul Siah Piakna
english: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”

paite: Ama'n, "Pe zel e,” achi hi. Huan insung a ava lut in, Jesu'n akiang ah, "Simon, bangchi in na ngai a? Lei a kumpipate'n siah leh leiman sumte kua a pan ahia alak zel uh? Atate ua pan hia, mituam a pan?" chi in ana gentuh hi.
english: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”

paite: Peter in, "Mituam a pan," achihtak in, Jesu'n akiang ah, "Huchi ahihleh tate awl uh ahi mai vo oi.
english: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.

paite: Himahleh nang tuipi ah va hoh inla, ngakuai diah inla, nga hong suak masapen man in, akam kek lechin dangka nih na mu ding; huaite la inla kei leh nang a ding in akiang uah pia in, huchi lou in zaw amaute i hihlungkim kei kha ding," achi hi.
english: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”
